Just had my first $JD Joybuy experience in France.

Quite a smooth experience. The packages arrived in less than 48 hours, and the platform design is minimal which doesn’t feel like a Chinese platform at all.

(Sorry for the mess, I haven’t cleaned the room 😅) https://t.co/iXFR9los81

体验相当顺畅。包裹不到 48 小时就到了，而且平台设计很简洁，完全不像一个中国平台。

（不好意思房间有点乱，我还没打扫 😅）
